comment: Every decision spec in app/specs is built here with its full model, or awaiting the builder, with the reason the builder cannot take it yet. The awaiting list only shrinks (BS-01). New decisions join at the end, so the claim ids of those before them never move.
name: me
title: me
purpose: A Prism of its owner, run only in the owner's browser: it differentiates what reaches the owner into parts and routes each where it belongs.

awaiting.chronology: its fields are all numbers, so no choice field can factor its 14-rule chain and omega cannot split it; it needs a comparison decision tree in the builder
awaiting.curate: a keyword facet of ten fields (tools/holon/gen.py); the builder's vendored prism-code takes at most eight, and lifting that needs an upstream prism-code patch
awaiting.dest: a keyword facet of nine fields (tools/dest/gen.py); the builder's vendored prism-code takes at most eight, and lifting that needs an upstream prism-code patch
awaiting.kappa: its examples are raw kappa strings read by a reader (read, axes), not field-level requests, so they are not the builder's examples; it needs a reader in front of the decision table (tools/kappa/gen.py)
awaiting.resonance: the builder's proofs of its seven-field table (1920 requests, an 18-rule chain factored on gesture) fail in the kernel: omega cannot prove any of inv001Holds to inv016Holds (LLV7002), since the factored steps leave if-chains it does not split; it stays on tools/facet/gen.py's tree until the builder's factoring splits
awaiting.router: the builder's proofs of its table (720 requests, a 13-rule chain factored on value) fail in the kernel: omega cannot prove any of inv001Holds to inv015Holds (LLV7002), since the factored steps leave if-chains it does not split; it stays on tools/facet/gen.py's tree until the builder's factoring splits
awaiting.uorc: the builder's proofs of its eight-field table (576 requests, 14 properties) are rejected in the kernel: lexlean verify fails PrismUorcProofs with LLV7002 and an empty Lean message, so no theorem of it is proved; it stays on tools/uorc/gen.py's tree until that is diagnosed
